blocks.text: Ohio Valley and Appalachian varieties; also found elsewhere in the U.S.

A documented grammatical pattern, not exclusive to the region and not an error. You may hear it beyond Ohio too, so let’s keep the map open. Oh, a tiny sentence can have its own local rhythm. I like noticing the pattern without treating somebody’s everyday speech as a mistake.
